sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) No tax of any kind shall be imposed except in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament or pursuant to a procedure lawfully prescribed and having the force of law by virtue of a law enacted by Parliament. (2) The provisions contained in subarticle (1) of this Article shall not prevent the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar from exercising its power to impose any tax in accordance with the powers of that Council.
